args.reason: Every DoD item serves the first PRD goal (inspect the current merge-eligibility decision without risking a merge): merge-ok and blocked outcomes are reported, and a test double asserts no `gh pr merge` call. Nothing in the DoD goes beyond the declared goals; there is no history storage or query. Reusing the existing floor reads keeps the floor logic as the single source of truth, so the second goal is respected. No gold-plating, and no cited goal is left unserved.
